title: Wire tensile strength
intro: A wire's tensile strength has μ = 520 MPa and σ = 24 MPa. For samples of n = 36, x̄ has mean 520 MPa and standard error 24/√36 = 4 MPa. The probability that x̄ falls between 512 and 528 MPa (μ ± 2 standard errors) is 0.9545, and the middle 95 % of sample means runs from 512.16 to 527.84 MPa.
